summary.text: Nic Kipke is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 31 in Anne Arundel County who is running for the Maryland State Senate in District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has served in the House since 2007 and was House minority leader from 2013 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Nicholaus Kipke was born in Baltimore on January 26, 1979, and attended Chesapeake High School and Anne Arundel Community College.
He was a restaurant manager for FriendCo Restaurants from 1995 to 2000 and has been a manufacturer representative with REPS & Associates, Inc., since 2000.
Kipke has served in the Maryland House of Delegates since 2007 and served as minority leader from 2013 to 2021.
According to the General Assembly website, he serves on the Health Committee and the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.
Ballotpedia lists him as not running for re-election to the House in 2026, and he advanced from the Republican primary for the Senate seat on June 23, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Kipke described himself as a conservative and an independent thinker and said he has tried to be a responsive leader who prioritizes constituent service.
He listed lower taxes, lower utility bills and restraining state budget growth as his key campaign messages.

He said he has worked to support small businesses, including community pharmacies, and listed endorsements from the National Federation of Independent Business, the Farm Bureau and the National Rifle Association of America.
